deals.comment: Kids Note, Inc. acquired additional 9.12% stake in Awins Co., Ltd. from Heedong Park for approximately KRW 270 million on March 27, 2020. Under the terms of the transaction, Kids Note will acquire 2487 shares for KRW 110000 per share. Post transaction, Kids Note, Inc. holds 824.45% stake and Heedong Park ows 17.55% stake.

Kids Note, Inc. acquired an additional 5.5% stake in Awins Co., Ltd. from Park, Hee-dong for approximately KRW 170 million on April 9, 2021. As reported, Kids Note, Inc. acquired an additional 1,500 shares in Awins Co., Ltd. at a price of KRW 110,000. Following the transaction, Kids Note will increase its stake in Awins Co. to 88% while Park, Hee-dong will reduce his stake from 17.5% to 12%.

Clove Club Co., Ltd agreed to acquire Krispy Studio Corporation for KRW 2 billion on April 23, 2021. The deal is subject to approval from board. The deal is expected to be completed by April 23, 2021.

3Y Corporation Inc. agreed to acquire Blue Tie from individual entrepreneur for approximately KRW 500 million on November 2, 2021. The transaction is resolved by the board of directors of 3Y Corporation and expected to complete on November 04, 2021.

Ground X Corp. agreed to acquire a 10.28% stake in Contxtsio Inc. for KRW 1.1 billion on April 1, 2022. Under the terms, Ground X Corp. will acquire, 1,230 shares representing 10.28% stake in Contxtsio. Transaction is excepted to close on April 4, 2022. For the year ended 2021, Contxtsio had total assets of KRW 19 million, total equity of KRW 16 million and Net income of negative KRW 85 million.
